faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Foreigners Tribunal Chirang Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Data Entry Operator posts is 10 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the office by this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Data Entry Operator posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Data Entry Operator position under the Foreigners Tribunal Chirang Recruitment 2026 notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Data Entry Operator posts is Offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Data Entry Operator in Foreigners Tribunal Chirang?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Data Entry Operator post will receive a salary of Rs. 10,000/- per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Higher Secondary (10+2) and possess a Computer Diploma/Certificate Course of minimum 6 months duration from a government-recognized institution.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for OBC/MOBC (43 years) and SC/ST (45 years) categories.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for Foreigners Tribunal Chirang Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Data Entry Operator posts. The application process is free.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: The selection process for Data Entry Operator posts includes a Typing Test followed by Document Verification. Candidates must clear both stages for final selection.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for these posts?
faq.answer: The job location for the Data Entry Operator posts is Kajalgaon, Chirang district, Assam, with pincode 783386. It falls under the Government of Assam.

faq.question: Q10. When was the official notification released?
faq.answer: The official notification for the Foreigners Tribunal Chirang Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026 was released on 03 August 2026, as per the important dates section.
